4448028921.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We believe the future of software development is AI-native — where engineers operate at a higher level of abstraction and quality remains non-negotiable.

Incubyte is a software craft consultancy where the “how” of building software matters as much as the “what”.

We partner with companies of all sizes, from helping enterprises build, scale, and modernize to early-stage founders bring their ideas to life.

Our engineers operate in an AI-native development model, using AI as a collaborator across the SDLC to accelerate development while upholding the discipline of software craftsmanship. Guided by Software Craftsmanship and Extreme Programming practices, we build reliable, maintainable, and scalable systems with speed, without compromising quality. If this way of building software resonates with you, we’d like to talk.

Our Guiding Principles

These principles define how we work at Incubyte. They are non-negotiable.

Relentless Pursuit of Quality with Pragmatism

We build high-quality systems without losing sight of delivery.

Extreme Ownership

We take responsibility end-to-end for decisions, execution, and outcomes.

Proactive Collaboration

We collaborate closely, challenge each other, and solve problems together.

Active Pursuit of Mastery

We continuously improve our craft and raise our bar.

Invite, Give, and Act on Feedback

We seek, give, and act on feedback to get better every day.

Ensuring Client Success

We act as trusted partners and focus on real outcomes, not just output.

Experience Level

This role is ideal for engineers with 3+ years of experience who are passionate about building high-quality software using modern Java technologies and Angular.

As a Software Craftsperson (SC-II), you'll work in product teams that take full ownership—from design and development to deployment—following eXtreme Programming (XP) practices such as pair programming, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and test-first development.

What You'll Do as a Software Craftsperson

  • Own feature-level design, delivery, and quality across backend and frontend applications.
  • Build reliable, maintainable, and testable software using clean code principles and disciplined engineering practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, designers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Work in an AI-native development model by leveraging AI tools to accelerate development while maintaining engineering quality.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by mentoring peers and refining engineering practices.
  • Participate in modern development workflows including CI/CD and collaborative software development.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

Backend – Java

  • 3+ years of Java development with strong fundamentals.
  • Experience with Micronaut or Spring frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design principles, and design patterns.
  • Good knowledge of Java Collections and Multithreading.
  • Experience with Hibernate ORM.
  • Familiarity with build tools such as Gradle or Maven.
  • Experience writing unit tests using JUnit.

Frontend – Angular

  • Hands-on experience building scalable applications using Angular and TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding of Angular fundamentals including:
  • Components
  • State Management
  • Data Binding
  • Routing
  • Directives
  • Pipes
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.

Database & DevOps

  • Experience working with relational databases.
  • Experience debugging and performance tuning applications.
  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) frameworks.
  • RxJS for reactive programming in Angular.
  • Fundamental SQL knowledge.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring best practices.

AI-First Development

You'll be expected to embrace AI as an integral part of the development workflow by:

  • Leveraging AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Augment, and Claude Code to accelerate software development.
  • Using AI to identify potential bugs, code smells, and performance issues early in the development lifecycle.
  • Applying prompt engineering techniques to improve AI-assisted development.

Founded in 2009, CLO's interconnected and ever-growing product ecosystem is built to power the future of everything related to garments.


 


CLO Virtual Fashion currently has 16 offices located in 13 countries across North America, Asia, Europe, and South America, and continues to expand to serve users around the globe.


[Position Overview]




We are recruiting colleagues to participate in the backend development of CLO Virtual Fashion's global web-based platforms and services. This position involves playing a crucial role in designing and implementing advanced backend services by directly participating in clothing content management and collaboration platforms such as CLO-SET and CONNECT.


 


You will be responsible for the development and implementation of the backend API server and various worker services, which are responsible for the stability and scalability of the platform service. Furthermore, you will gain experience in and lead the integration of search data essential for service operations, as well as the integration of various backend technologies for large-scale data processing. Ultimately, through close collaboration with various related departments, including the frontend, you will have the opportunity to design the overall functionality of a global platform service specialized in clothing content and create a high-quality product.

  • Web-based service backend development

  • Development experience using RDBs such as MSSQL

  • Clear and flexible communication skills to collaborate seamlessly with other teams/roles



Plus if you have

  • Experience in developing and operating complex workflows using workflow platforms such as Airflow

- Full Time Employment

Job Summary

Trellint is seeking a Java developer leader with Relational database backend experience, and a forward-thinking approach to AI-augmented development. Your primary responsibility will be to design and develop complex transportation applications on different layers of the infrastructure to build scalable solutions with modern AI tooling integrated into every phase of the development lifecycle. A commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and product quality is essential.

Job Description

Job Description:

  • Responsible for the functional software design and development of major complex system software components, using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to augment code completion, generate unit tests, and accelerate delivery.
  • Responsible for delivering production-quality code for presentation, middle-tier, and data-tier layers, with AI assistance for code completion, refactoring suggestions, and identifying potential bugs.
  • Responsible for evaluating AI-generated code contributions for correctness, security, and adherence to standards.
  • Partners with product and technical leads to review and finalize requirements; use AI summarization tools to rapidly synthesize documentation and user stories.
  • Responsible for effectively and responsibly integrating AI coding assistants into their workflows.
  • Own developer testing for assigned projects; use AI-powered test generation tools to achieve high coverage while reducing manual test-writing effort.
  • Resolve technical issues in new and existing code through systematic debugging; apply AI-assisted root cause analysis to accelerate issue resolution.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for development procedures, standards, and design using AI writing assistants to improve consistency and clarity.
  • When required, analyze, diagnose, and resolve complex production issues from client environments.
  • Database: Oracle 19c and MS SQL.
  • Git is our current source code repository, and we are utilizing Apache Maven as our build tool and Jenkins for Continuous Integration.

Skills

  • Proven experience developing enterprise Java applications; proficiency with JDKs 1.6+, JEE6, JDBC, and SQL.
  • Experience with Java Web Services, JUnit, and version control (Git/Subversion).
  • Hands-on experience with IBM WebSphere and MQ Manager.
  • Solid Linux knowledge; Red Hat Enterprise Server experience desirable.
  • Strong grounding in Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD), Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD), UML, and Agile Software Development.

4452513153.descriptionHtml:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

About Amtech

Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.

With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:

Purpose

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

Growth

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

Culture

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

Innovation

Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

Role Description

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working in a large, mature enterprise codebase and solving real-world operational problems. Success requires curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a complex environment. You'll work on software that supports corrugated manufacturing operations, including scheduling, production control, plant-floor interfaces, reporting, and system integrations.

Key Responsibilities

Java Platform

  • Strong Core Java experience using modern language features (Java 17).
  • Experience with multi-module Gradle builds.
  • Solid understanding of Java EE technologies, including:
  • Servlets
  • EJB 3 (Session and Entity Beans)
  • JPA with Hibernate
  • Container-managed transactions (JTA)

Application Server & Deployment

  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting applications on Apache TomEE/OpenEJB.
  • Familiarity with WAR/EAR packaging, datasource configuration, and container administration.

Data & Integration

  • Strong SQL Server skills, including:
  • SQL development and optimization
  • Database schema design and analysis
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful HTTP APIs.
  • Working knowledge of JSON serialization libraries such as Jackson or Gson.

Development Environment

  • Windows-based development experience.
  • Comfortable working in a Windows-based development environment (the team primarily uses Eclipse).
  • Experience with PowerShell and Windows batch scripting for build, deployment, and operational tasks.
  • Proficient with Git and GitHub workflows.

Skills & Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus.

  • Reporting: BIRT 4.19
  • Desktop UI development with Java Swing and SwingX.
  • Experience designing manufacturing or industrial touchscreen user interfaces.
  • Familiarity with transport layers: TCP/IP, Serial
  • Testing with JUnit 4.

Nice To Have

  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash
  • Ideal candidates combine engineering depth with governance awareness
  • Industry certifications preferred, such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or AWS Security Specialty

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. 4452210948.descriptionHtml:
Role: Engineer 2 - Java

Experience: 3-5 years

Location: Bangalore

Employment Type: Full-time


About

Styli Marketplace Launched in 2019 by Landmark Group, Styli Marketplace is the first e-commerce venture of the group, quickly becoming a leading online destination for fashion and lifestyle across the GCC, including Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, and beyond. We connect global sellers and creators with millions of fashion-forward customers, offering the latest trends, exceptional value, and convenient services like same-day to 48-hour delivery and flexible payment options. Our mission is to make style accessible, aspirational, and exciting for all, backed by a passionate team fostering a culture of creativity and innovation. At Styli, we aim to revolutionize fashion retail and bring unique experiences to our customers.


Key Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable, and secure Java-based applications using Spring Boot, JPA, and Hibernate.

• Work with both SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB) databases.

• Implement and optimize RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

• Leverage cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) for deploying, monitoring, and scaling applications.

• Integrate message queue systems (Pubsub / Kafka / RabbitMQ / SQS / Azure Service Bus) for asynchronous processing.

• Contribute to data lake and data warehouse solutions, ensuring efficient data ingestion, processing, and retrieval.

• Collaborate with frontend teams if needed (knowledge of React/Angular is a plus).

• Troubleshoot and debug complex issues, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

• Follow industry best practices in coding standards, security (OWASP), CI/CD, and DevOps methodologies.

• Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and work closely with cross-functional teams.


Mandatory Skills & Qualifications:

• 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA.

• Strong expertise in SQL & NoSQL databases, query optimization, and data modeling.

• Proven experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) – Lambda, EC2, S3, Azure Functions, GCP Cloud Run, etc.

• Knowledge of message queue systems (Pubsub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, SQS).

• Familiarity with data lakes (Delta Lake, Snowflake, Databricks) & data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse).

• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps). • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and performance tuning skills

• Hands on in the Microservice environment.

• Experience in eCommerce and Deep hands-on technical expertise

• Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment


Good to Have (Plus Skills):

• Frontend experience with React.js/Angular.

• Knowledge of GraphQL, gRPC, or WebSockets.

• Understanding of AI/ML integration in backend systems.

• Certifications in cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) or Java/Spring. Industry Best Practices Knowledge Expected:

• Design Patterns (Microservices, Singleton, Factory, Observer, etc.)

• Security Standards (OAuth2, JWT, SSL/TLS, Data Encryption)

• Performance Optimization (Caching, DB Indexing, Load Balancing)

• Observability (ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch) • Agile & DevOps Culture (Scrum, SAFe, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code)


Soft Skills:

• Strong analytical and communication skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous learning.

4449391486.descriptionHtml:
About Olyv

Olyv is India's fastest-growing, fully automated next-generation fintech company focused on addressing the credit requirements of self-employed micro-entrepreneurs, micro-merchants, and middle and lower-income salaried individuals. In addition to lending solutions, our platform offers digital gold savings, credit health products, and other financial wellness solutions.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, Olyv was founded in 2017 with the mission of driving financial inclusion for the underserved market. With over 13 million users and presence across 19,000+ pin codes, Olyv leverages AI and ML-powered technology to deliver instant, fully digital credit solutions at scale. The company is backed by leading investors and has been recognized globally for its contributions to financial inclusion.


Our Culture

At Olyv, we are passionate about solving complex customer problems through technology and innovation. We foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, empowering our teams to build world-class products that create meaningful impact. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are excited about transforming the FinTech ecosystem, Olyv is the place for you.


About the Role:

As an SDE-II at Olyv, you'll be a key contributor to our mission of Olyv. You'll work within a

dynamic and collaborative team of experienced product managers, engineering leaders

and business stakeholders to design, develop, and maintain high-quality software

solutions that delight our customers.


Qualifications - Education: Btech in Computer Science, Engineering from IIT.


Experience:

• 2.5+ years of experience in software development.


Responsibilities:

• Design and Develop: Architect, design, and implement scalable, efficient, and

maintainable software components.

• Agile Methodology: Embrace agile principles and practices to deliver features iteratively

and incrementally.

• Technical Expertise: Demonstrate a strong understanding of software development

concepts, tools, and technologies, including security, performance, reliability, and

maintainability.

• Mentorship and Collaboration: Mentor junior engineers (SDE-1s), share knowledge, and

foster a positive team culture.

• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements, reduce technical debt, and

optimize development workflows.

• Quality Assurance: Ensure code quality through practices like code reviews, unit testing,

and static analysis.

• CI/CD: Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for efficient

software delivery.


Requirements:

• 2.5+years of professional software development experience, preferably in a product-based

ora consumer internet company.

• Proficient in Java, with a strong grasp of Java > 8 features and extensive hands-on

experience.

• A deep understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts, design patterns,

and data structures.

• Experience with frameworks like Spring Boot, play and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, orAzure) and database technologies (MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB) and messaging queues like KAFKA/RabbitMQ.

• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.

• A passion for building scalable and high-performance systems.

• A collaborative mindset and a commitment to delivering exceptional results.


Additional Skills (Preferred):

• Knowledge of distributed systems and microservices architecture.

• Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools.

Scope

  • Contribute to the development, testing, and maintenance of Blue Yonder's cloud-native Supply Chain Data Platform.
  • Work closely with senior engineers to build scalable microservices, implement new features, resolve defects, and continuously improve product quality while developing technical expertise in distributed systems and cloud technologies.

Our Current Technical Environment

  • Software: Java, Spring Boot, Gradle, Git, Hibernate, REST APIs, OAuth, GraphQL, Snowflake, Scala, Spark, Elasticsearch, NoSQL, RDBMS
  • Application Architecture: Cloud-native, event-driven, secure multi-tenant microservices architecture with high scalability, resiliency, and high availability
  • Cloud Architecture: Microsoft Azure (AKS, ARM Templates, Azure AD, Event Hub, Application Gateway, Virtual Networks, HDInsight), Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD
  • Frameworks/Others: Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, Spring Boot, Hibernate, GraphQL, Elasticsearch, Spark, Ignite, Git, Gradle, DevOps, Infrastructure Automation

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software features using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with product managers, architects, QA engineers, and senior developers to deliver scalable and reliable software solutions.
  • Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, code reviews, testing, and retrospectives.
  • Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues while continuously improving code quality, performance, and reliability.
  • Participate in the engineering on-call rotation to provide backend production support, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to platform reliability.
  • Continuously learn new technologies, engineering best practices, and contribute to improving team processes and development standards.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, SQL, Git, and object-oriented programming principles.
  • Good understanding of cloud-native application development, distributed systems, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with messaging platforms like Kafka, databases such as Snowflake, NoSQL/RDBMS, and modern software development practices including CI/CD and DevOps.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, eagerness to learn new technologies, good communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative Agile environment.

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

4255729977.descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary:

Responsible for coding, unit testing, building high performance and scalable applications that meet the needs of millions of Walmart-International customers, in the areas of supply chain management ; Customer experience.

About Team:

Our team collaborates with Walmart International, which has over 5,900 retail units operating outside of the United States under 55 banners in 26 countries including Africa, Argentina, Canada, Central America, Chile, China, India, Japan, and Mexico, to name a few.

What you'll do:

Architect, Design, build, test and deploy cutting edge solutions at scale, impacting millions of customers worldwide drive value from data at Walmart Scale

Interact with Walmart engineering teams across geographies to leverage expertise and contribute to the tech community.

Engage with Product Management and Business to drive the agenda, set your priorities and deliver awesome product features to keep platform ahead of market scenarios.

Identify right open source tools to deliver product features by performing research, POC/Pilot and/or interacting with various open source forums

Develop and/or Contribute to add features that enable customer analytics at Walmart scale

Deploy and monitor products on Cloud platforms

Develop and implement best-in-class monitoring processes to enable data applications meet SLAs

What you'll bring:

Min 2.5 - 6 years of web based application development experience

Demonstrates up-to-date expertise in building enterprise grade web based applications.

Proficient in GUI technologies like React.js , JavaScript, HTML, CSS.

End to end knowledge of full stack web application development using JAVA/ Springboot, Kafka, RESTFul services, API and other frameworks.

Passionate about building user friendly, intuitive web applications to solve complex business problems.

Extremely strong technical background, being hands-on and earn the respect and ability to mentor top individual technical talent.

Good experience of working with globally distributed teams in a collaborative and productive manner. Excellent interpersonal skills, good with people, ability to negotiate.

Retail experience is huge plus

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. Thats what we do at Walmart Global Tech. Were a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the worlds leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.

Flexible, hybrid work

We use a hybrid way of working with primary in office presence coupled with an optimal mix of virtual presence. We use our campuses to collaborate and be together in person, as business needs require and for development and networking opportunities. This approach helps us make quicker decisions, remove location barriers across our global team, be more flexible in our personal lives.

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting, and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being welcoming of all people.

4453876466.descriptionHtml:
Job Title

Associate Java Developer - IT Master Data

Summary

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Associate Web Application Developer (Java Full Stack) to join our IT team. In this role, you will support the development, enhancement, and maintenance of enterprise web applications and digital platforms. You will work closely with the Master Data organization and business stakeholders to ensure master data is accurate, complete, and aligned with established standards and best practices. You will help developing data governance processes, workflows, and approval mechanisms while supporting new business requirements, internal policies, and external compliance requirements. Working alongside experienced Master Data specialists, business analysts, application teams, and functional experts,

Responsibilities Include

  • Developing, testing, and maintaining enterprise web applications using Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, REST APIs, and relational databases, focusing more on Master data governance.
  • Develop user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and exposure in any modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Support the development and integration of RESTful APIs with internal and external applications.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following coding standards.
  • Develop unit tests and support integration testing to ensure software quality.
  • Collaborate with developers, business analysts, Business stake holders, QA engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver project objectives.
  • Support application enhancements, maintenance activities, and production issue resolution.
  • Continuously learn new technologies, development tools, and enterprise software engineering practices.

Qualifications

The following are required for the role

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Min 2+ years of hands-on experience in Java application development or equivalent internship/project experience.
  • Understand of Enterprise master data structure and workflows (Material/Product etc)
  • Basic programming skills in Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and RESTful Web Services.
  • Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and software development fundamentals.
  • Basic knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
  • Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and willingness to learn modern front-end frameworks such as React or Angular.
  • Exposure to Git or other version control systems.
  • Basic understanding of Agile methodologies and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Good analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Strong willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to changing business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to Enterprise Master data processes.
  • Understanding of GTC, Supply chain, Production quality, finance modules.
  • Understanding of Hibernate/JPA, CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps).
  • Basic knowledge of secure coding practices and software quality principles.

What We Offer

At Momentive, we value your well-being and offer competitive total rewards and development programs. Our inclusive culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and provides diverse career opportunities to help you unleash your full potential. Together, through innovative problem-solving and collaboration, we strive to create sustainable solutions that make a meaningful impact. Join our Momentive team to open a bright future. #BePartoftheSolution

About Us

Momentive is a premier global advanced materials company with a cutting-edge focus on silicones and specialty products. We deliver solutions designed to help propel our customer’s products forward—products that have a profound impact on all aspects of life, around the clock and from living rooms to outer space. With every innovation, Momentive creates a more sustainable future. Our vast product portfolio is made up of advanced silicones and specialty solutions that play an essential role in driving performance across a multitude of industries, including agriculture, automotive, aerospace, electronics, energy, healthcare, personal care, consumer products, building and construction, and more.

Momentive believes a diverse workforce empowers our people, strengthens our business, and contributes to a sustainable world. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any characteristic protected by law.

To be considered for this position candidates are required to submit an application for employment and be of legal working age as defined by local law. An offer may be conditioned upon the successful completion of pre-employment conditions, as applicable, and subject to applicable laws and regulations.

Note to third parties: Momentive is not seeking or accepting any unsolicited assistance from search and selection firms or employment agencies at this time.

4434525582.descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will bring your general software engineering expertise to our innovative projects and continuously evolving concepts. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud technology, stay on top of trends, and drive projects with an ever-increasing degree of independence. This is a unique opportunity for talented engineers to push their boundaries and think big.

The work you’ll do:

  • Innovate beyond our existing products and bring new ideas to life for Celonis.
  • Ensure high quality and continuously improve procedures and practices.
  • Work closely with your fellow engineers, project managers, and designers to create cohesive and efficient solutions.
  • Collaborate with adjacent teams to drive a holistic project success spread across multiple geographies
  • Learn and grow, not only in technical expertise but also in any other necessary aspects of making our projects reality.
  • Brainstorm with the entire Celonis Labs team, research potential solutions, and ultimately bring them to life.

The qualifications you need:

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering) or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience (mandatory) as Backend Engineer with strong expertise in building microservices based products using Java, Spring framework, JPA, Hibernate is a must.
  • Experience with building data pipelines in Databricks, ETL, Apache spark is a big plus.
  • Relational databases; PostgreSQL a plus.
  • Proficient in building cloud-native distributed systems.
  • Able to demonstrate a generalist skill set across multiple technical areas besides the Backend, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Ability to analyse and design complex software.
  • Experience building scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems.
  • Proven background in building cloud-native software in the Kubernetes ecosystem, as well as with and on Hyperscalers such as AWS.
  • Deep understanding of modern engineering practices (Git strategy, CI/CD, testing, …) and how to apply these to enable a team of multiple engineers.
  • Problem-first attitude: you’re able to understand the needs of our customers and see technology as a means to an end, not an end in itself.
  • Ability to quickly learn new things without tight supervision.
  • Problem-solving attitude.
  • Collaborative team spirit.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

4452975907.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Blitz is on a mission to revolutionize e-commerce delivery in India, enabling 60-minute fulfillment and delightful customer experiences. As a q-commerce enabler, we empower leading brands like Decathlon, Adidas, Puma, and Purplle by transforming their e-commerce stores into rapid delivery powerhouses. Powered by advanced AI agents across the supply chain, Blitz delivers 2-hour/4-hour deliveries from retail or dark stores and same-day delivery from warehouses, driving nearly 50% lower RTOs, 50% higher conversion rates, 98% delivery success, and 3x customer loyalty.

﻿Key Responsibilities

  • Take complete ownership of projects from ideation to execution.
  • Design and deliver user-centric solutions that address core business challenges with seamless experiences.
  • Optimize existing architectures for performance, scalability, and functionality.
  • Write modular, scalable, and clean code following best practices.
  • Deploy and maintain project infrastructure ensuring zero downtime.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience), preferably from Tier-1 institutions.
  • Strong strategic communication and presentation skills.
  • Proven ability in real-world problem solving using first-principles thinking.
  • Proficiency in Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django), and Golang.
  • Hands-on experience with database design, RDBMS (PostgreSQL), and NoSQL databases.
  • Skilled in writing unit and integration test cases.
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming and technologies.
  • Familiarity with cloud services (e.g., AWS EC2, Cognito, API Gateway, ECS).
  • Experience with pub-sub technologies (SQS, Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Knowledge of caching tools (Redis, Hazelcast).
  • Exposure to DevOps practices and Big Data (a plus).
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns (Microservices, CQRS, Domain-Driven Design).
  • Proficiency with GenAI tools and “vibe coding,” backed by solid fundamentals.
  • Mandatory exposure to Artificial Intelligence / AI Engineering.

This job is to be part of the dynamic Payment switching product development team which caters to the needs of the Fintech space. The core technology expected is Java with Spring framework.

Roles and Key KPIs

  • Work with development teams and product managers to ideate software solutions.
  • Design client-side and server-side architecture.
  • Design scalable solution with detailed technical documentation.
  • Develop and manage well-functioning databases and applications.
  • Write effective APIs.
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade software.

  • This is a full-time position reporting to Technical Manager, and regular hours of work and days are Monday through Friday, 10:00 a.m. to 7 p.m.

Preferred Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or related field and/or equivalent formal training or work experience.
  • Requires 3 to 6 years qualifying work experience in information technology or engineering environment.

4447552770.description: DescriptionJob Title: Software Engineer - JavaEmployment Type: PermanentWork Location: Chennai India - HybridAbout CloudBeesCloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.About The RoleWe use Claude Code every day and are pushing agentic AI further into how we work. If you want to be on a team figuring out what AI-assisted engineering actually looks like on a real, complex product (not a sandbox), this is it.CDRO (Continuous Delivery & Release Orchestration) is CloudBees' enterprise CD product. It's been running in production at some of the world's largest engineering orgs for over a decade. Hundreds of engineers depend on it to ship software safely and on schedule.We're a team of about 10, distributed across India, France, Spain, and the US. We're not chasing the next hype cycle feature. We operate a product real customers depend on, modernize it while keeping it stable, and do it with a small team that takes ownership seriously.Key ResponsibilitiesMost teams try AI coding tools on greenfield work. 4447552770.descriptionHtml:
Description

Job Title: Software Engineer - Java

Employment Type: Permanent

Work Location: Chennai India - Hybrid

About CloudBees

CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.

Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.

CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.

Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.

About The Role

We use Claude Code every day and are pushing agentic AI further into how we work. If you want to be on a team figuring out what AI-assisted engineering actually looks like on a real, complex product (not a sandbox), this is it.

CDRO (Continuous Delivery & Release Orchestration) is CloudBees' enterprise CD product. It's been running in production at some of the world's largest engineering orgs for over a decade. Hundreds of engineers depend on it to ship software safely and on schedule.

We're a team of about 10, distributed across India, France, Spain, and the US. We're not chasing the next hype cycle feature. We operate a product real customers depend on, modernize it while keeping it stable, and do it with a small team that takes ownership seriously.

Key Responsibilities

Most teams try AI coding tools on greenfield work. We're doing something harder: applying them to a decade-old enterprise codebase with real customers depending on it. CDRO's core is Java 21 with a significant Groovy layer. The work is a mix of internal cleanup that makes the codebase easier to evolve, and direct improvements that make customers' lives better.

Concretely:

  • Own Java work across the core: REST API, pipeline execution engine, persistence layer
  • Continuously reduce complexity: modernize older subsystems, shrink the product surface area where it makes sense, improve test coverage, and leave the codebase easier than you found it
  • Use Claude Code as a normal part of your workflow, to move faster without skipping thought
  • Write tests that prove things work. Shift-left, not "QA will catch it."
  • Document what you build. We're async across timezones. If you know something the team needs to know, write it down.
  • Actively avoid being a single point of failure for anything you own


Qualifications

Required:

  • Solid Java. You've worked professionally at least 4 years developing Java software, in production codebases that weren't yours, in systems that mattered if they broke.
  • Strong AI awareness: you know what Claude Code, or Cursor, etc. do. You've played with some of them at least.
  • Relational database experience: SQL, JPA/Hibernate, schema migrations. Oracle or PostgreSQL background is a strong advantage.
  • Comfort in large, mature codebases. You can navigate unfamiliar code, form a hypothesis, test it, and stay functional when you don't understand everything at once.
  • Testing discipline. You write unit and integration tests as part of the work, not after.
  • Honest communication. If something is blocked or broken, we need to know. We're async and distributed.


Strong plus:

  • Active use of Claude Code to ship real work, not just tab completion. Bonus: you want to push it much further than you do today.
  • Groovy. Willingness to pick it up fast matters more than prior credentials.
  • Kubernetes/Helm: deploying and debugging workloads, not just using them.
  • Experience evolving established systems: migrations, incremental rewrites, dependency upgrades.


Preferred (not mandatory):

  • Jenkins or CI/CD internals
  • Distributed systems infrastructure: message brokers (ActiveMQ, Artemis, RabbitMQ), coordination (Zookeeper)
  • React/TypeScript: the UI is adjacent and not your main domain, but not being afraid of it helps


Who This Is For

  • You're a Java engineer who finds large, evolved codebases interesting rather than off-putting. You've seen what breaks when systems are poorly documented and owned by one person. You build the opposite.
  • You want hard engineering problems, real ownership, and a team that says what's true. With ~10 people on the team, you'll touch meaningful parts of the system fast. You'd rather evolve a product real enterprises depend on than build a greenfield service nobody's relying on yet.


Working Conditions

  • Standard working hours: 9:30 a.m. – 6:30 p.m., Mon–Fri, or as per business needs
  • Work location / travel expectations: Hybrid
  • Reasonable accommodations will be considered in line with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.


Equal Opportunity Statement

CloudBees is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste, religion, color, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

Data Protection Statement

All personal information collected during the recruitment process will be handled in accordance with applicable Indian data protection laws and CloudBees privacy policy.

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to provide a summary of the position and its responsibilities. It is not an exhaustive list of duties. Responsibilities and activities may evolve as per organisational requirements.

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Java Backend Developer to support and enhance enterprise Warranty Applications. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Java-based web application development using JSP, Servlets, and Struts framework, along with experience in application support, troubleshooting, maintenance, and enhancement of critical business systems.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, QA teams, support teams, and architects to deliver reliable and scalable solutions supporting warranty and after-market business processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise Warranty Applications using Java technologies.
  • Analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Develop backend components using Core Java, JSP, Servlets, and Struts framework.
  • Support production applications and troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring issues.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with QA teams during testing cycles and support defect resolution.
  • Work closely with business users during requirement gathering, UAT, and production deployments.
  • Prepare technical documentation, design documents, and support knowledge articles.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming.
  • Ensure compliance with security, audit, and change management processes.
  • Support application modernization and migration initiatives as required.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

Work Experience

Required Technical Skills

Core Technologies

  • Strong hands-on experience in:
    • Core Java
    • J2EE
    • JSP
    • Servlets
    • Struts Framework (Struts 1.x / Struts 2.x)
Database

  • Oracle / MYSQL/ DBeaver/TOAD
  • Stored Procedures

Web Technologies

  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • AJAX

Integration

  • REST APIs
  • SOAP Web Services
  • XML / JSON

Tools & Platforms

  • Eclipse
  • Git / GitHub
  • Maven
  • Azure DevOps
  • SonarQube

Application Support

  • Incident Analysis & Resolution
  • Production Support
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • Defect Tracking
  • Change Management

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to Servlets, Spring Framework and Struts
  • Experience with OpenShift, AWS or Azure cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience working in global delivery teams.
  • Understanding of application security best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4–8 years of experience in Java application development and support.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.

4450706243.descriptionHtml:
Back End Developer II

People behind the solutions

At Fuller Technologies we know that building a strong team starts with creating opportunities for growth. For over a century, we’ve supported the people behind the solutions, fostering a culture where hard work is valued, learning is encouraged, and teamwork drives success.

Here, you’ll find the tools and support to develop your skills and take your career further. Join us and become part of a company that values your contributions and is committed to helping you succeed—every step of the way.

About The Department

The Online Reliability Services Software Development team builds customer-facing digital products that improve equipment reliability and performance for cement producers worldwide. As Fuller Technologies expands its in-house software development capabilities, this growing team offers a unique opportunity to influence technology, engineering culture, and future product innovation.

About The Role

As a Backend Developer II, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that power our global Online Reliability Services (ORS) platform. You will build cloud-native applications, APIs, and IIoT data services that enable reliable connectivity between industrial equipment, cloud platforms, and digital solutions.

In this role, you will independently deliver high-quality software features while collaborating with cross-functional teams to continuously improve platform performance, scalability, security, and operational reliability.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs.
  • Build cloud-native applications supporting Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) connectivity and data processing.
  • Develop reliable machine-to-cloud data integration services.
  • Optimize backend performance, scalability, availability, and maintainability.
  • Design and implement database structures and data processing workflows.
  • Participate in software architecture discussions and technical design reviews.
  • Contribute to CI/CD automation, monitoring, and production support activities.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues using structured root cause analysis.
  • Apply secure development practices throughout the SDLC, including IEC 62443 cybersecurity principles.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers, DevOps engineers, product managers, and domain experts to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews and technical guidance.
  • Support continuous improvement of development standards, tooling, and engineering practices..

You bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience in backend software development, building and supporting scalable production applications.
  • Strong programming experience with Java, Python, C#, Node.js, or comparable backend technologies.
  • Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, distributed applications, and microservices-based architectures.
  • Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, and backend data-management principles.
  • Experience developing and deploying cloud-native solutions using Microsoft Azure services.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and modern DevOps practices.
  • Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile development methodologies.
  • Working knowledge of secure software development practices and cybersecurity principles; exposure to industrial or IIoT cybersecurity is an advantage.
  • Strong systems thinking, analytical, troubleshooting, and complex problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve application and platform issues.
  • Ability to translate technical requirements into reliable, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and other technical teams.
  • Experience working in global and cross-functional environments is an advantage.
  • A quality-focused and continuous-improvement mindset with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.

As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.

Application and contact

Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.

No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.

Build a better world

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.

For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https://www.fuller-technologies.com/

4454967078.descriptionHtml:
About Chargebee

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.


Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.


About the Team

You'll join the CRM Integrations team, a group of engineers based across India working on seamlessly integrating Chargebee with leading CRM platforms. The team partners closely with Product Management, Customer Success, Support, and other engineering teams to deliver integrations that strengthen Chargebee's position as the preferred subscription billing solution for enterprises. We value thoughtful problem-solving, async collaboration, and learning together


About the role

You will be a key member of the CRM Integration team, driving initiatives to seamlessly integrate Chargebee with leading CRM platforms. In this role, you will own and evolve the current CRM integration solutions to ensure Chargebee customers experience smooth and scalable integration. You will partner with cross-functional teams to deliver integrations that strengthen Chargebee's position as the preferred subscription billing solution for enterprises.


What you’ll do

  • Ideate, design, and develop CRM integration applications/services with a focus on data accuracy and reliability.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers to design and build robust CRM connectors.
  • Write hands-on code to build frameworks or middleware that facilitate integrations.
  • Actively maintain functional and non-functional quality through automated tests, data validation checks, and integration-specific API automation.
  • Own integration quality by performing effective code reviews and proactively identifying issues in data sync or API consumption.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve customer-reported issues with urgency and clarity.
  • Champion adoption of Agile practices within the team.
  • Author and maintain technical documents and API specs, ensuring clarity for engineering and other teams.


What you’ll bring

4-7 years of proven experience in building distributed systems to handle high throughput, low latency, and event-driven architecture.

  • Strong knowledge of Java, Distributed Systems, SQL, and NoSQL databases, and a basic understanding of JavaScript frameworks like Vue, React, or Angular.
  • Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, Webhooks, GraphQL, and data synchronization patterns.
  • Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn enterprise CRM platforms like Salesforce and integrate with them.
  • Experience working on large-scale systems in the Cloud.
  • Experience creating/supporting production-grade systems with proven ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
  • Strong debugging skills with tools such as Postman, Datadog, and Splunk.
  • Excellent communication skills — ability to simplify complex integration scenarios for both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Effective team player with experience mentoring and guiding junior engineers.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like JIRA/Confluence.


Nice to have

  • Experience building and managing enterprise-grade integrations is an advantage.
  • Prior work experience in HubSpot or Salesforce CRM is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with observability tools like New Relic or Datadog.


Benefits we offer


At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. Our commitment to supporting our employees is universal, while our benefits are thoughtfully designed to meet the unique needs of each region. We offer comprehensive packages that generally include:

  • Health & Wellness: Robust coverage and access to programs to support your physical and mental well-being.
  • Financial Security: Initiatives to help you build long-term financial stability.
  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible options and resources to help you thrive both professionally and personally.


Chargebee is an equal opportunity employer. At Chargebee, we believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences is not a “good-to-have” but a “must-have” as it strengthens us as a company and as individuals. Job Description

Senior Software Engineer - Intermodal

Title: Senior Software Engineer

Type of Work: Full-time

Location: India - Chennai

Reports to: Dhanasekaran Venkatesan

About The Role

Kaleris is a private equity-backed software firm focused on supply chain optimization, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are a global leader in the supply chain execution market, focused on accelerating the transformation of digital supply chain for industrial and finished goods shippers and carriers by combining best-in-class solutions for challenges tied to yard management, shipment visibility, and asset management, across rail, truck, and multi-mode transportation.

We are seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our team and drive our Rail Products to the next level.

This role focuses on developing innovative solutions to address and enhance workflows at intermodal/inland rail facilities, optimizing the way cargo moves across rail networks. You will play a key role in shaping the architecture and expanding the functionality of our intermodal rail solutions, delivering high-impact software that improves efficiency, visibility, and performance for our global rail customers. We are offering a competitive remuneration package including several first-rate benefits such as bonus, health insurance, life insurance, onsite parking and flexible working arrangements.

Responsibilities

  • Join an Agile team coordinating with a Product Manager, Lead Developer, and QA Lead
  • Collaborate with product management, professional services and QA teams to deliver features and functionality
  • Create new product features for our global customers using test driven development
  • Identify and develop solutions for bug fixes and changes to a range of applications
  • Participate in the full development life-cycle from definition and design to product delivery
  • Provide first-hand supervision and guidance to software engineers on assigned activities
  • Take end-to-end ownership of your part of the functionality
  • Wake ownership of a product feature and drive design, coding and feature reviews
  • Work on every level of the stack – frontend to backend, and everything in between
  • Some international travel to customers and our other offices may be required at times

4454273360.descriptionHtml:
Are you excited to work with a variety of products and technologies in a collaborative and supportive environment?

Do you enjoy sharing knowledge and learning with colleagues from diverse backgrounds?

About The Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions supports organizations around the world with innovative tools for risk assessment. Our insurance division delivers advanced technology and analytics that help drive better decision-making throughout the insurance policy lifecycle. We’re committed to creating positive outcomes for our clients by improving efficiency and reducing risk. Learn more about our Insurance Risk Solutions on our website https://risk.lexisnexis.com/insurance.

About The Team

Our teams are structured in inclusive and collaborative squads, each consisting of a Squad Lead, Business Analyst, Dev Lead, Developers, and Testers. This structure fosters strong connections and empowers members to contribute their unique perspectives and deliver outcomes together.

About The Role

This position performs moderately difficult research, design, and software development assignments within a specific software functional area or product line. The position should have the ability to work on individual pieces of work and solve problems including the design of the program flow of individual pieces of code, effective coding, and unit testing.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with technical personnel and team members to finalize software requirements and understand product requirements.
  • Develop and review detailed specifications and translate moderately complex requirements into effective software designs.
  • Implement software development processes, coding best practices, and participate in code reviews.
  • Develop, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues and complete bug fixes across various development environments.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders in Agile, Waterfall, and other development methodologies.
  • Work with Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Microservices, Hibernate, JPA, Cosmos DB, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Configure and support services using Docker, Helm, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud environments such as Azure, with a focus on performance optimization.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and contribute to technology migrations and related initiatives, including Java upgrades, Kafka/EventHub, Databricks, and Python as applicable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Software Engineering experience.
  • BS in Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Strong Java experience; Java 8 required, with Java 11/21 experience preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Microservices, Hibernate, JPA, and Cosmos DB.
  • Experience with performance optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Docker, Helm, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitHub Actions preferred), and Azure cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Kafka/EventHub and strong understanding of REST APIs and distributed systems.
  • Java migration experience (8 → 11/21), Databricks, and Python are good to have.

Learn more about our team and culture here

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

4458635043.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Java Backend Developer


Role Overview :

We are seeking an experienced Java Backend Developer with 5+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend systems. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture, and database technologies. This role involves developing high-performance enterprise applications, building secure APIs, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver robust business solutions.


Key Responsibilities :


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and implement RESTful APIs and Microservices-based architectures.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following coding standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers, business analysts, and QA teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Work extensively with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
  • Design and implement database schemas, queries, and stored procedures.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues in development and production environments.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and release management activities.
  • Support CI/CD processes and contribute to DevOps best practices.
  • Required Skills & Experience5+ years of experience in Java Backend Development.
  • Strong expertise in Core Java (Java 8 or above).
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and Spring Data JPA.
  • Extensive experience in developing RESTful APIs and Microservices.
  • Experience with Hibernate/JPA for ORM and database interaction.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
  • Experience with Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or messaging frameworks is desirable.
  • Knowledge of Git, Maven, Gradle, and build automation tools.
  • Good understanding of Multi-threading, Collections, Design Patterns, and JVM concepts.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Preferred SkillsExperience working with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
  • Understanding of security best practices and application monitoring tools.


Preferred Experience :


  • Building scalable enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing Microservices Architecture.
  • Experience integrating third-party services and APIs.
  • Experience working with high-volume transactional systems.
  • Experience in performance tuning, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in large-scale development projects.


Job Location Chennai


Interested candidates kindly share your resume to sagana.sannasiperumal@kumaran.com

Job Description

Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. IT Equities Technology

Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores.

This role will focus on the design, development, enhancement, and support of strategic trading and servicing systems used by a global Securities Finance user base.   • Familiarity with Airflow, Snowflake, and AWS QuickSight.
  • Exposure to financial services, Securities Finance, Prime Services, or trading systems.
